worlds.line: As they try to change their worlds
stanza: I watch the ripples change their size
But never leave the stream of warm impermanence and
So the days float through my eyes
But still, the days seem the same
And these children that you spit on
As they try to change their worlds
Are immune to your consultations
They're quite aware of what they're going through

worlds.songTitle: The Harder Ships of the World
worlds.line: We sail the harder ships of the worlds
stanza: We sail the harder ships of the worlds
To the greater grips of the land
And we get closer to nowhere

worlds.line: Orisons of all the distant worlds
stanza: I call you now first Rider
Clasp the wings above the heart
Altar of smoke and the sycamore
The cypress grove and the funeral drum
Orisons of all the distant worlds
And after worlds to come

worlds.line: And all the gods in all the worlds
stanza: He stumbled into faith and thought
"God, this is all there is"
The pictures in his mind arose
And began to breathe
And all the gods in all the worlds
Began colliding on a backdrop of blue
